svg.aria-label: Where timing data goes. This process: counters for 79 MDK operations and 37 Linux stages fill up across all accounts, keep nanosecond totals locally, and reset on restart or module reload. Debug > Timings: you click Refresh and Copy JSON, empty metrics show zero samples, and WN_TIMINGS writes the JSON on normal exit. With consent: MDK exports aggregate histograms over OTLP in whole milliseconds to otlp.ipf.dev/v1/metrics, never to Goggles' audit-logs endpoint.
